name: Mercille
desc:
Mercille is a Vesperian NPC that's part of [The Summer Company](faction:the_summer_company). They're on a team mission with [The Guy](entity:the_guy), [Sierra](entity:sierra) and [Prentis](entity:prentis). They shares a common dislike for The Guy with Prentis and Sierra.

You can turn sacks found in [Starswept Valley](location:the_starswept_valley) and [Bluster Rift](location:bluster_rift) to them for a chest, much like the Summer Company's explosive crates found on [Summer Isle](location:summer_isle) that can be delivered back to [Scope](entity:scope). Doing so will grant a normal Starswept Valley chest as well as some Summer Company reputation.
